text: また　おあいて　して　いただけますの？

structure.jp: おあいて　して　いただけますの？
structure.en: could I have you be my opponent?

patterns.name: 〜ていただく
patterns.span: して　いただけます
patterns.explanation: いただく after a て-verb means you humbly receive the favor of someone doing it. いただけます is the 'can' form, so it asks 'could I have you do it?'. おあいて　して　いただけます = 'could you be my opponent'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a question softens it, and after ます it sounds like a refined lady. いただけますの = 'might I have that favor?'.
